name: lemnaria-configurator
//scripts: Recursive scripts run with --workspace-concurrency=1 on purpose. Several packages depend on @lemnaria/configurator-domain and each builds it via its own build:deps, so running them concurrently puts multiple tsc processes on the same dist/ and produces spurious 'error type' lint failures on a cold tree.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

//pnpm: overrides.@vercel/blob>undici: @vercel/blob 2.8.0 (latest) declares undici 6.x and resolves 6.28.0, which carries GHSA-rfgv-xxqx-mfg5 (high), GHSA-3wwx-pv8p-q78v and GHSA-r53p-7pc4-xj5r, all patched in 6.28.1. @vercel/blob declares undici ^6.23.0, so a lockfile refresh alone now resolves a patched 6.x; the pin keeps the audit gate from regressing on a stale lockfile. Drop it once the lockfile no longer needs it.
